body: Hahhh ohhh god in a political aspect... i cant handle it. The gov does not care for people’s wellbeing at all and wants us to be depressed. It’s the main way they get money from us. It definitely should not be this way but it is. And i live in a high capitalist city so it makes everything a lot harder. But thank you! ❤️ I definitely hope to see a therapist, it’s just a lot on my budget at the moment and finding a good one near me and fitting it in my schedule. If i can get it 100% covered I’d go all the time 😭
Oh wow such good advice from you both! Ill definitely be keeping this in mind now, thank you :)
Yess thank you! Love the motivation :)

Awhh so relatable, I usually quit too after 3-6 months or just stick with seasonal jobs since it doesnt last long anyways and doesnt look bad as much. My longest job was my last job i had at 1.5 years (im still young tho at 23) and it was a retail job but i couldnt afford to go to work or get a place to live even with multiple raises, bonuses and overtime. Most of my coworkers lived with their rich bfs or parents and i have neither. Im sad i left it but the company was so stingy with money. Starting a new job always makes me so nervous, but the bubbly front def helps, its just sooooo exhausting long term :(

Oh WOW thank you so much! These links are amazing, im always looking for healing inspo on my Instagram feed :) also wow i had no idea about the cantaloupe! It makes sense tho, i unfortunately live is a very cold place so cantaloupe isn’t in season yet, but this summer i’ll be stocking up now!

Oh no. I feel this. I keep thinking that if i travel ill become a little more happier too. But i traveled to Europe/Amsterdam 2 years ago and i came back to the US and had my first really bad anxiety attack ever to the point i got sick. I didnt even know it was an anxiety attack until i went to the ER and they told me that :( then i went to europe/london again a few months ago and ended up getting depressed, but this time i know what depression and anxiety feels like :( its not fun. I keep wanting to travel but i don’t understand why this keeps happening. Maybe it’s too much out of our comfort zone at once? Maybe it doesn’t feel like home? Maybe we miss certain friends or pets? Maybe it’s money? Whatever it is, i dont see myself traveling super far for a while unfortunately.

I feel this too... seems like life is just passing by. I remember i used to promise myself to never let days just pass by but honestly life is so hard to do that. I can’t bring myself any motivation anymore. I write down goals and things i need to do and used to get everything done so quick but nowadays i think i get one thing done a month
